_about: The Empire goal list after Act 1 (Alex, approved 2026-11-18; docs/REVIEW_2026-11-24.md section 2 and section 7's pacing: Act 1 is about 25 game days, so one goal every two days or so, the last near day 25). scripts/empire_goals.gd shows the first three not yet done, top left, and any of them can be done. Each has an id, a line (every line is a DRAFT until Alex approves it), a check the code reads, n (how many; default 1) and a reward in coins (drafts, 20 to 150c). Checks: caught, penned, combed, fibre_knits, face_sales, requests count from the moment the goal first shows (so what she did in Act 1 doesn't tick it off); needles (has that pair or better), pens (that many pens), barn (Lars's barn rented and paid up), guide_seen (species seen in the Field Guide), designs (designs knitted for the Lookbook), best_day (coins from sweaters in one day, the morning ledger's best), ready (the last one: sets Game.flags["act_ready"] for the time skip).

goals.line: Catch a wild animal with the dog (Tab, then bark)
Lead a wild animal home to a pen
Comb a wild animal for its fibre
Knit a sweater with wild fibre
Sell a sweater to someone face to face
Find five animals for the Field Guide
Knit ten designs for the Lookbook
Earn 1,000c from sweaters in one day
